acquisition_verification.verification_requirement: Recheck exact byte count and SHA-256 before every fold; abort on mismatch.

approved_by: RSNA project owner via direct Ticket 39 implementation instruction; recommended experiment defaults delegated

release_eligibility.release_gate: Requires separate resolution and owner approval for checkpoint/derivative rights and competition winner-release obligations.

rights_basis: The project owner directly instructed implementation of Ticket 39 and delegated recommended experiment defaults. This project-level decision authorizes only the bounded private reference-only Ticket 39 comparison using the exact already acquired and reverified checkpoint, with layer4 and the fold-specific head trainable. It relies on the same competition-use interpretation recorded for Ticket 32 and does not grant source-side rights, resolve ImageNet terms, or authorize checkpoint/derivative publication, redistribution, final-candidate freeze, or release.

scope_details.data: Use the exact corrected 58-study reference cohort, folds 0/1/2, and existing complete integration; held-out studies are prediction/evaluation only.
scope_details.experiment: Ticket 39 only: complete three-fold, gold-reference-only fine-tuning comparison against Ticket 32 frozen ResNet-18.
scope_details.processing: Slurm GPU only for real fine-tuning; one GPU, 16 CPUs, 64 GiB RAM, no external spend or runtime network.
scope_details.release: No promotion, final-candidate freeze, publication, redistribution, or release is authorized; derivatives remain private.
scope_details.resource_budget: One 30-minute two-step smoke; then one sequential request per fold, capped at six allocated GPU hours each; no retries; shared campaign cap remains 20 GPU hours.
scope_details.supervision: Gold reference labels only; no reports, weak labels, pseudo-labels, ImageNet source images, or fold-crossing fitted artifacts.
scope_details.training: Only ResNet-18 layer4 and each fold-specific head are trainable; all earlier encoder stages and batch-normalization running state remain frozen.
